claims.evidence: Witness photos show the keyboard and a lit blue LCD, but do not confirm sound output, all keys working, or speaker health.
Photos do not provide clear condition details like scratches/dents/key wear or missing/loose parts.

risks.risk: Exact Yamaha model is not readable, so feature set and value (voices/styles/keys count) are unknown.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model number/name label (front panel or back panel) where text is readable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Yamaha full-size electronic keyboard with unknown model/features.

risks.risk: Functionality risk: may not produce sound correctly or may have dead keys; speaker/audio quality may be weak or distorted.
risks.proof: A short video showing power-on, playing multiple keys across the full range, and a quick test of built-in speaker output (no distortion/crackling).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully guaranteed working (worst-case: partial key/sound issues).

risks.risk: Cosmetic/physical condition risk: scratches, dents, worn keys, or loose/missing buttons/knobs may reduce usability and resale value.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the keybed, top control area, and front panel (including corners/edges) in good light.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming moderate wear and possible cosmetic imperfections.

risks.risk: Connectivity/accessories risk: missing power adapter, sustain pedal, cables, or malfunctioning ports (headphone/USB/MIDI/line-in/out).
risks.proof: Photos of all included accessories laid out + close-up of ports; video showing sustain pedal input (if available) and headphone/line-out test.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming accessories may be incomplete and ports may be untested.

risks.risk: Speaker health risk: LCD can light up even if speakers are damaged; volume limits or one-side failure may exist.
risks.proof: Video playing a chord/scale at low and medium volume with clear audio from the built-in speakers.
risks.if_unproven: Price as speaker output unverified (worst-case: needs repair or limited volume).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the exact Yamaha model number (front or back label) where text is readable.
Send a short video: power on (LCD visible), then play multiple keys across the full range to confirm no dead keys.
Send a video of built-in speaker audio quality (no crackling/distortion) at low and medium volume.
Show close-ups of all buttons/sliders/knobs and the keybed for wear or missing parts.
List and photograph included items (power adapter, sustain pedal, cables, mic/stand if any) and show the ports working (headphone/line-out/USB-MIDI if present).
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Yamaha full-size electronic keyboard with a lit LCD and visible speaker grille, but the photos do not verify core value drivers like exact model, full key/sound functionality, and included accessories. Without those, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
